info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Trade Settlement Review-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of trade settlement reviews, enabling financial institutions to manage and assess the accuracy of trade settlements. Users can submit reviews for specific trade settlement transactions, allowing for enhanced validation and audit processes. Financial analysts and compliance teams are typical consumers of this API, ensuring that trades meet required standards and regulations. The API plays a crucial role in improving operational integrity and transparency within market operations.

post.summary: Create a new review for a trade settlement.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified trade settlement resource (RES-100045). Reviews help provide feedback and insights regarding the trading operations, improving overall service quality.
